channel.title: Empowered Vote changelog
channel.description: What changed on Empowered Vote, every Tuesday and Friday.

item.title: Essentials: You can now look up Santa Cruz and Santa Cruz County, plus Corte Madera and Marin County, in California. In Santa Cruz you can also see where most of the city council stands on Compass topics.
item.description: You can now look up Santa Cruz and Santa Cruz County, plus Corte Madera and Marin County, in California. In Santa Cruz you can also see where most of the city council stands on Compass topics. https://essentials.empowered.vote

item.title: Treasury Tracker: Reno and Washoe County are now on Treasury Tracker, our first local governments in Nevada, read from their own annual financial reports.
item.description: Reno and Washoe County are now on Treasury Tracker, our first local governments in Nevada, read from their own annual financial reports. https://treasurytracker.empowered.vote

item.title: Treasury Tracker: For many cities and counties in California, South Carolina and Maryland, the source link under a chart opened a statewide table or a landing page. It now opens the document the figures came from.
item.description: For many cities and counties in California, South Carolina and Maryland, the source link under a chart opened a statewide table or a landing page. It now opens the document the figures came from. https://treasurytracker.empowered.vote

item.title: Essentials: When a new officeholder's term begins, your address lookup now shows them that day, instead of the person they replaced.
item.description: When a new officeholder's term begins, your address lookup now shows them that day, instead of the person they replaced. https://essentials.empowered.vote

item.title: Platform-wide: The home page has new words: shorter, a little warmer, and now calling us antipartisan. The newsletter page is easier to read in dark mode, too.
item.description: The home page has new words: shorter, a little warmer, and now calling us antipartisan. The newsletter page is easier to read in dark mode, too. https://empowered.vote

item.title: By the numbers: Essentials now has profiles for more than 14,000 officials and candidates, up 27 since Tuesday. Governments with budget data on Treasury Tracker are up 2, to more than 11,000.
item.description: Essentials now has profiles for more than 14,000 officials and candidates, up 27 since Tuesday. Governments with budget data on Treasury Tracker are up 2, to more than 11,000. https://empowered.vote/briefing/2026-11-13

item.title: Not launched yet: We also made progress on Read & Rank and Empowered Listening.
item.description: We also made progress on Read & Rank and Empowered Listening. https://empowered.vote/maps/purpose-map.html

item.title: Treasury Tracker: Treasury Tracker has a new Payments view, where you can read the individual payments a city made to vendors, straight from its check register. Los Angeles, Plano and West Hollywood also gained earlier years.
item.description: Treasury Tracker has a new Payments view, where you can read the individual payments a city made to vendors, straight from its check register. Los Angeles, Plano and West Hollywood also gained earlier years. https://treasurytracker.empowered.vote

item.title: Essentials: Essentials now covers Reno and Washoe County, our first local governments in northern Nevada.
item.description: Essentials now covers Reno and Washoe County, our first local governments in northern Nevada. https://essentials.empowered.vote

item.title: Compass: For several days, Compass couldn't load your saved answers if you were signed in. That's fixed.
item.description: For several days, Compass couldn't load your saved answers if you were signed in. That's fixed. https://compass.empowered.vote

item.title: Platform-wide: You can now add your address with a basic account. We keep only your voting districts, never the street address itself.
item.description: You can now add your address with a basic account. We keep only your voting districts, never the street address itself.

item.title: Security and privacy: We fixed a security warning on our backend database.
item.description: We fixed a security warning on our backend database.

item.title: By the numbers: Essentials now has profiles for more than 14,000 officials and candidates, up by more than 320 since Friday. Civic Trivia's live questions are up 10.
